title: How to Prep for an Interview (with ChatGPT) 🔎
description:
One of the more nerve-racking things about job interviews is not knowing what the hiring manager will ask you. Using ChatGPT you can actually have it give you a set of POSSIBLE questions to practice with. There’s no way to guarentee the reaults will actually be what you are asked but this is a great way to practice. #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips #jobinterviewquestions #jobsearchtips #careertok #careeradvice #chatgpt
